title: The Role of Mitochondria in Athletic Performance: A Scientific Perspective - Carbon IV Performance Coaching
abstract:
### Enhancing Mitochondrial Biogenesis Through Training  
Exercise is one of the most effective methods to enhance mitochondrial function:  
- **Endurance Training:**Stimulates peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator-1 alpha (PGC-1α), a key regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
- **High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT):**Increases mitochondrial density and efficiency in both fast- and slow-twitch muscle fibers.
- **Strength Training:**While primarily anaerobic, resistance training complements mitochondrial adaptations in endurance sports.
### Nutritional Strategies for Mitochondrial Health  
Certain nutrients support mitochondrial function and efficiency:  
- **Coenzyme Q10 (CoQ10):**Enhances electron transport chain efficiency and reduces oxidative stress (Garrido-Maraver et al., 2014).
- **Omega-3 Fatty Acids:**Support mitochondrial membrane integrity and ATP synthesis (Lanza et al., 2013).
- **Resveratrol and Polyphenols:**Activate sirtuins and PGC-1α, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis (Lagouge et al., 2006).
- **Carnitine:**Facilitates fatty acid transport into mitochondria for oxidation (Stephens et al., 2007).
